events.summary:
SVRJKL

The National Weather Service in JACKSON KY has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Western Harlan County in southeastern Kentucky...
Northeastern Bell County in southeastern Kentucky...
East central Knox County in southeastern Kentucky...
Southwestern Leslie County in southeastern Kentucky...
Southeastern Clay County in southeastern Kentucky...

* Until 1045 PM EDT.

* At 956 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Saylor, or 10
miles northwest of Harlan, moving southeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Wallins Creek around 1000 PM EDT.
Loyall around 1005 PM EDT.
Harlan around 1010 PM EDT.
Liggett around 1015 PM EDT.

Other locations in the path of this severe thunderstorm include
Martins Fork and Martins Fork Lake.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Beaufort, SC; Charleston, SC; Colleton, SC
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Beaufort County in southeastern South Carolina...
Charleston County in southeastern South Carolina...
Colleton County in southeastern South Carolina...

* WHEN...Until 1145 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways. Overflowing poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 954 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms with
torrential rainfall extending from Wiggins and Bennetts Point to
Edisto Island with lighter rainfall extending up into lower
Charleston County. As much as 2 to 4 inches of rain have fallen
in this area this evening. An additional 1 to 2 inches could fall
through 1145 PM. A risk for minor flooding of low-lying and poor
drainage areas continues.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Beaufort, Edisto Beach, Johns Island, James Island, Folly Beach,
Seabrook Island, Kiawah Island, Rockville, Bennetts Point and
Edisto Island.

Chesapeake Bay from Smith Point to Windmill Point VA...
